test_title: PYST 17: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 8 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Responsibility**". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Responsibility**" means the duty of being answerable. 

 
 
• **Example:** *Harry's **responsibility** was to make sure that the costumes were good.* 
 
 
 
• Therefore, the appropriate answer is "responsibility". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Facility** - amenities

 
 
• **Example: ***This apartment has all the required **facilities**.*
 
 
 
• **Complexity** - difficulty
 
 
• **Example: ***The **complexity** of the exam was high.*
 
 
 
• **Opportunity** - a chance
 
 
• **Example**: *Gaby got an **opportunity** to play for the state. *
